name: Cod Tikka Masala over Pilau Rice with Cucumber, Tomato & Mint Salad

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water, turmeric, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cup water
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring often, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup virgin coconut oil
1 ½ tbsp garam masala
1 ½ tbsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
3 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes, cream, and sugar to the pot. Stir to combine the tikka masala sauce and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
355 ml heavy whipping cream
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce is cooking, pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into 2-inch pieces.
When the sauce is done, use a hand blender to purée until smooth. Alternatively, use a potato masher to crush the veggies (the sauce will be chunkier).
Return the sauce to medium-low heat. Add the cod and cook, stirring occasionally, until opaque and flesh flakes with a fork, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallots. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the shallot.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumbers; add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl along with salt and pepper, then stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide rice between plates and top with cod tikka masala. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
